summary_en: 500,000 shares (2.24% of S/O ex-treasury), ¥500M upper limit, open-market purchase window 13 Aug–30 Oct 2026. All acquired shares to be cancelled on 30 Nov 2026.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares and Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 12 August 2026, Atrae Inc.'s board of directors approved a treasury-share acquisition and cancellation programme under the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 500,000 ordinary shares (2.24% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum aggregate consideration of ¥500 million via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 13 August and 30 October 2026. All shares acquired under the programme will be cancelled effective 30 November 2026. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and enable flexible capital policy in response to changing business conditions. As of 12 August 2026, the company held no treasury shares and had 22,315,341 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
